# Dr Pushkar Sobti, All-on-X Implantologist, Delhi

> Dr Pushkar Sobti (BDS, MDS, PG in Oral Implantology, UCAM University) is a dental implant specialist in Delhi, India, with 18 years in practice, more than 5,000 implants placed and more than 500 full arches restored. Dr Pushkar Sobti focuses on All-on-4, All-on-6 and All-on-X full-arch implants with fixed teeth, including zygomatic and pterygoid implants for severe bone loss. Dr Pushkar Sobti practises at Dr Sobti's Dental Care, a family practice run by Dr Pushkar Sobti's father since 1982 (Dr Pushkar Sobti in independent practice since 2009), a fully digital implant clinic in Rajouri Garden, New Delhi, which treats local and international patients.

## Key facts
- Clinic: Dr Sobti's Dental Care, J 12/26, First Floor, Rajouri Garden, New Delhi 110027, India. Second branch in Vishnu Garden, New Delhi 110018.
- Hours: 10 am to 7 pm, 7 days a week
- Clinic website: https://sobtidentalcare.com
- Google rating: 5 stars from 200+ reviews
- Memberships: ISOI, AOI, IDA. Languages: English, Hindi.
- Implant systems: Nobel Biocare NobelActive TiUltra, Hiossen ET IV, Osstem TS IV CA
- Prices: All-on-4 from INR 3,00,000 per arch; single implant with crown from INR 35,000 (guided surgery, Osstem implant, custom abutment, zirconia crown, 3-year warranty); zygomatic implants from INR 80,000 per implant; pterygoid implants from INR 50,000 per implant
- Treatments: All-on-4, All-on-6, All-on-X, full-mouth rehabilitation, same-day fixed teeth, immediate implants, single implants, implant bridges, zygomatic and pterygoid implants, bone grafting, sinus lift, PRF, implant maintenance
- Digital setup: MyRay X5 CBCT; Medit i900, Medit i500 and Upcera intraoral scanners; exoplan and Blue Sky Bio planning; 3D-printed surgical guides; exocad smile design; in-house CAD/CAM milling (Roland, Upcera, Kelkar); ISQ stability meter; piezosurgery; PRF centrifuge; dental microscope; conscious sedation; Class B sterilisation
- International patients: from the US, Canada, UK, Germany, Italy, France, Denmark, Poland, Russia, Ukraine, Kazakhstan, Iran, Saudi Arabia, Nigeria, South Africa, Sri Lanka, Malaysia, Indonesia, Australia and New Zealand. Free online assessment answered by Dr Pushkar Sobti within 24 hours; medical visa invitation letter; partner hotels; paid airport pickup; typical full-arch stay about 15 days; payment by card, cash or bank transfer.
